scenario: A translational oncology team studying ipsc derived neurons performs the following experiment: All 30 disease samples were sequenced in 2022 on Illumina NovaSeq (Batch 1), while all 30 control samples were sequenced in 2024 on Element AVITI (Batch 2). The PI asks: 'Can we apply ComBat to cleanly extract true disease biology?' They collect samples and execute computational modeling.
question: Critique the methodology of this ipsc derived neurons study. Identify any fatal methodological flaws, explain the underlying biological and statistical mechanisms, provide rigorous corrections, and establish whether reported biological claims are warranted.
ground_truth_rationale: Authoritative scientific rationale: Statistically indeterminate / mathematically inseparable: Because biological condition is 100% collinear with sequencing platform and year, no statistical batch correction algorithm (ComBat, limma, Combat-seq) can separate biological differential expression from technical batch artifacts without independent control replicates. In ipsc_derived_neurons biology, failing to account for this leads to erroneous translational conclusions.
